# utils.solver.validate_layer_thicknesses { #climatecritters.utils.solver.validate_layer_thicknesses }

```python
utils.solver.validate_layer_thicknesses(dz, n_layers=None)
```

Validate positive layer thicknesses.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**dz**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[array](`array`) - [like](`like`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Layer thickness values.

<code>[**n_layers**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[int](`int`) or None]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Expected number of layers.  If provided, the size of ``dz`` must match.  Default ``None`` (no size check).

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[**dz_arr**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[ndarray](`ndarray`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Validated, flattened float array.

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[ValueError](`ValueError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If the size does not match ``n_layers`` or any thickness is ≤ 0.
